title: Referrer-Policy header missing
description: The response sets no Referrer-Policy header, so browsers fall back to a default that can leak full page URLs — including tokens or identifiers in query strings — to third-party sites.
remediation: Send Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or tighter) on every response. Keep sensitive identifiers out of URLs regardless of policy.
limitation: Header presence only: the value is not validated, so a present-but-lax policy still passes this check.
